preconditions.description: The input is a string containing the full standard input.

preconditions.expression: len(lines) == T + 1 and all(isinstance(int(line), int) and 1 <= int(line) <= 10**9 for line in lines[1:]) and 1 <= T <= 1000
preconditions.description: The input consists of T+1 lines where the first line is an integer T (1 <= T <= 1000) and the subsequent T lines each contain a valid integer N (1 <= N <= 10^9).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout_lines[i]) == (sum(26**((k + 1) // 2) for k in range(1, int(lines[i + 1]) + 1)) % 1000000007) for i in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case i, the output line i contains the count of palindromes of length 1 to N modulo 1000000007, where the count for a specific length k is 26 raised to the power of ceil(k/2).
